tip: The reflexive ending -ся (-sya) on оборачивается (oborachivayetsya = turns) points the action back at the subject.
For ‘about’ use о (o): позаботься о себе (pozabotsya o sebe = take care of yourself), об (ob) before a vowel.
The verb боюсь (boyus = I fear) takes its object in the genitive: боюсь темноты (boyus temnoty = afraid of the dark), not the accusative.
Imperfective future is будет (budet = will be) plus an unchanged infinitive: будет готовить (budet gotovit = will cook).
Possession uses the genitive after the noun: голос певца (golos pevtsa = the singer's voice), literally voice of-the-singer.
готовиться к (gotovitsya k = to prepare for) takes the dative: готовились к отъезду (gotovilis k otyezdu = we prepared for departure).
The position word перед (pered = before, in front of) takes the instrumental: перед экзаменом (pered ekzamenom = before the exam).
у (u = by, near) plus the genitive marks location: у окна (u okna = by the window), from окно (okno = window).
A single perfective verb states the future: прочитаю (prochitayu = I will read and finish), no будет (budet) needed.
The verbs звонить (zvonit) and позвонить (pozvonit = to call) take the dative person: позвоню тебе (pozvonyu tebe = I will call you).
Imperfective past marks a repeated habit: встречались каждый день (vstrechalis kazhdyy den = used to meet every day).
жаловаться на (zhalovatsya na = to complain about) takes the accusative: жалуется на головную боль (zhaluetsya na golovnuyu bol = complains about a headache).
с (s = with) takes the instrumental: соглашаемся с планом (soglashaemsya s planom = agree with the plan), from план (plan).
In the third person свой (svoy = one's own) keeps it clear: построили свой дом (postroili svoy dom = built their own house).
вокруг (vokrug = around) takes the genitive: вокруг озера (vokrug ozera = around the lake), from озеро (ozero = lake).
Russian drops is in the present: В деревне свежий воздух (v derevne svezhiy vozdukh = in the village there is fresh air) has no verb.
Add -ее for the comparative: умнее (umneye = smarter) from умный (umnyy = smart), then чем (chem = than) for the comparison.
в plus the accusative shows motion into: светит в глаза (svetit v glaza = shines into the eyes), direction not location.
A they-verb with no subject reads as passive: продают фрукты (prodayut frukty = fruits are sold), literally they sell.
по plus the dative plural marks a recurring time: по утрам (po utram = in the mornings), from утро (utro = morning).
